career_ladder.note: Diploma Trainees in POWERGRID undergo 1 year of training at S0 level and are absorbed as Junior Engineers (Grade-IV) at S1 supervisory level. Career progression is regulated by POWERGRID Non-Executive Career Growth Policy and internal departmental promotion examinations to executive officer cadres.

exam_scheme.note: Selection process consists of a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) carrying 100% weightage for final selection, followed by Document Verification and Pre-Employment Medical Examination. The CBT carries negative marking of 1/4th mark per incorrect response.

papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% for UR and 30% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD in Part I

papers.paper_name: Part II: Aptitude Test (AT) — English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, General Awareness
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% for UR and 30% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD in Part II

financial_package.note: During the 1-year training period, Diploma Trainees receive basic pay of ₹24,000 in scale S0 (₹24,000–₹1,08,000) with 58% DA, HRA, and 12% perks. Upon successful completion of training, candidates are regularized as Junior Engineer Gr-IV at S1 level in scale ₹25,000–₹1,17,500 with annual CTC of approximately ₹12.7 Lakhs.
financial_package.pay_level: IDA Supervisory Scale S1 (₹25,000 – ₹1,17,500) upon absorption; S0 (₹24,000 – ₹1,08,000) during training
financial_package.pay_source_label: POWERGRID Advt. CC/01/2026 Compensation Package and Pay Scale Table
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on absorbed Junior Engineer Entry Basic Pay of ₹25,000 at 58% IDA (₹14,500), Cafeteria perks and allowances up to 35% of Basic Pay (₹8,750), House Rent Allowance (9% to 27% = ₹2,250 to ₹6,750), less statutory Provident Fund (12% of Basic+DA = ₹4,740) and medical insurance deductions. Annual regularized CTC is approx. ₹12.7 Lakhs.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly as per AICPI
Perquisites and allowances under Cafeteria Approach up to 35% of basic pay
Performance Related Pay (PRP) based on corporation MoU performance ratings
Company Quarters in POWERGRID substations/townships or HRA in lieu thereof
Reimbursement of monthly conveyance expenditure, mobile, and laptop expenses
Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Pension & Leave Encashment
Comprehensive Group Insurance and Group Personal Accident Insurance
